SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.*, ROWNUM rnum FROM ( SELECT r.RESOURCE_ID AS RESOURCE_ID , r.RESOURCE_NAME AS RESOURCE_NAME , p.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME , p.RESOURCE_TYPE_CD AS RESOURCE_TYPE_CD , v.VERSION_NO AS VERSION_NO , r.ENV_CD AS ENV_CD , r.ORG_CD AS ORG_CD , r.EOS_STATUS_CD AS EOS_STATUS_CD , r.RISK_GRADE_CD AS RISK_GRADE_CD , r.EXCEPTION_ACTIVE_YN AS EXCEPTION_ACTIVE_YN , r.OWNER_USER_ID AS OWNER_USER_ID , l.EOS_YMD AS EOS_YMD , l.EOL_YMD AS EOL_YMD FROM TB_EOS_RESOURCE r JOIN TB_EOS_PRODUCT_VER v ON v.VERSION_ID = r.VERSION_ID JOIN TB_EOS_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = v.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EOS_PRODUCT_LFC l ON l.VERSION_ID = v.VERSION_ID AND l.EFFECTIVE_TO_DTM IS NULL
ORDER BY r.RESOURCE_ID ASC ) a WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{pageSize} ) WHERE rnum > #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EOS_RESOURCE r JOIN TB_EOS_PRODUCT_VER v ON v.VERSION_ID = r.VERSION_ID JOIN TB_EOS_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = v.PRODUCT_ID
